messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER (HIGH) - service=inference-runtime - region=prod-west - 50% 500s on /v1/generate. Auto-escalate to oncall. https://ops.redwood.example/incidents/1937654321
Mike: ack — I'm oncall. Starting mitigation runbook.
Sasha: I'm around, pulling logs now. Which model/route?
Mike: longctx workflows to model-gen-2, requests with seq_len>8k. Symptoms: KV cache allocation OOMs then 500s.
Sasha: grabbing pods: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep runtime` — seeing 3/5 pods Ready, OOMKilled on two.
Sasha: logs (tail):
```
2026-03-15T02:20:11Z ERROR runtime: failed to reserve kv_cache: cannot allocate memory
2026-03-15T02:20:12Z INFO router: request -> 500, seq_len=9200
```
Mike: thanks. Looks like autoscaler didn't add nodes. Linh, can you check autoscaler alerts?
Linh: checking ASG and metrics. CPU fine, but pod mem request > node allocatable due to recent model-profile bump. ASG didn't scale because node-level CPU < threshold.
Mike: ok, manual mitigation: scale deployment and revert the recent profile bump on model-gen-2. I'll scale to 6 replicas first.
Mike: `kubectl scale deploy/runtime --replicas=6 -n inference` — done, pods coming up.
Sasha: new pods Pending because of instance type constraints. I triggered a manual node launch. 
Marco: heads-up: rolling scale will cause brief increased latency; customers on long-context might see errors while warmup happens.
Eva: can we confirm customer impact window and affected tenants? We need to notify PMs and support.
Sasha: partial list: tenets with long-context flag (customer tags: ai-vision, research-pro). I'll export list and share after this thread.
Mike: mitigation progress: 3 new pods Ready, error rate dropping to 12%. Still seeing KV cache warnings. I'm reverting the model profile change — applying previous quantization profile.
Mike: `kubectl apply -f /infra/model-profiles/model-gen-2/profile-v2.yaml` — applied.
Sasha: after revert logs show allocation back to normal, error rate down to 1.7%.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE - error rate below threshold, paging resolved. Please initiate post-incident actions.
Eva: thanks team. Let's capture timeline and follow-ups. I propose: Mike to own the RCA writeup, Sasha to draft timeline and log snippets, Marco to own remediation (autoscaler tuning), Linh to verify node/ASG policy changes, Priya (Legal) to review customer comms. Can everyone ack?
Mike: ack — I'll own the RCA writeup and produce first draft today.
Sasha: ack — I'll drop a raw timeline + logs into the doc.
Marco: ack — I'll propose autoscaler thresholds and a runbook change.
Linh: ack — will validate node allocatable vs model requests and propose a fix for profile validation on deploy.
Priya: ack — I'll review the planned customer notification and sign-off legal language.
Eva: scheduling: postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00 PT. I'll create a calendar invite and share doc link.
Mike: quick ask — do we want a dry-run peer-review before we post the RCA? I can do a writeup then run it by SRE and Legal.
Eva: yes, please. Plan: draft -> internal dry-run with SRE/Legal -> incorporate feedback -> formal sign-off and customer note.
Sasha: draft checklist: 1) timeline with exact timestamps, 2) root cause hypothesis, 3) contributing factors, 4) mitigation steps taken, 5) lasting remediation, 6) customer impact summary, 7) action owners + due dates.
Mike: I'll start the doc and include the timeline. Attaching initial outline in thread:
```
- Incident start: 2026-03-15T02:19:48Z (first 500 observed)
- Pager triggered: 2026-03-15T02:21:05Z
- Mitigation start (scale): 2026-03-15T02:23:10Z
- Model profile revert applied: 2026-03-15T02:29:40Z
- Error rate < threshold: 2026-03-15T02:35:01Z
```
Mike: root cause (initial): model-profile change increased memory request beyond node allocatable for long-context workload, autoscaler thresholds were CPU-based and did not trigger. Contributing factors: no pre-deploy validation of mem vs node allocatable; autoscaler policy mismatch; insufficient canarying for profile changes.
Priya: for customer comms we need: impact window, affected tenants (high-level), actions taken, and contact for follow-up. Avoid technical deep-dives in the public note. I'll draft suggested language after the dry-run.
Marco: remediation proposals: A) Add memory-based autoscaler trigger, B) Add profile validation pre-deploy (fail deploy if model mem > node allocable), C) Canary rollout for profile changes, D) Add KV-cache allocation monitoring with alert at 10% failure. I'll put a PR for runbook changes.
Linh: I'll add a CI check to compute peak kv cache memory from model profile and compare to target node allocatable; will start a branch and ping for review.
Sasha: I've exported the affected tenant list and uploaded to the doc as a CSV (internal-only).
Mike: timeline drafting done. Next steps: I'll post a first-pass RCA in this doc by EOD PST, request dry-run 12:00 PT tomorrow with SRE+Legal, then finalize by 16:00 PT for sign-off.
Eva: sounds good. Priya, Marco please reserve 12:00–12:30 PT for the dry-run.
Priya: reserving.
Marco: reserved.
IncidentBot: Created postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.example/postmortems/1937654321 (access: private)
Mike: linking action items in the document:
- ACTION-1: Add memory-based autoscaler trigger (owner: Marco, due: 2026-03-22)
- ACTION-2: Pre-deploy profile validation CI (owner: Linh, due: 2026-03-19)
- ACTION-3: Canary rollout policy for model profiles (owner: Mike, due: 2026-03-26)
- ACTION-4: Customer notification draft and sign-off (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-17)
Sasha: I'll paste log snippets and `kubectl` commands into the doc under Appendix.
Eva: excellent. After dry-run we will mark RCA as ready for peer review and sign-off. Mike, please tag me once draft is in.
Mike: will do — uploading draft in ~2 hours.
Priya: also: keep a private timeline for legal if there are sensitive customers. I'll coordinate offline with support.
Marco: I'll open a PR for runbook edits and tag SRE reviewers.
Linh: CI branch created: `profile-validation/1937654321` — will open PR after tests pass.
Mike: thanks all. Great coordination. Closing the pager thread and moving to postmortem doc for drafting.
IncidentBot: PAGER CLOSED - followups moved to postmortem doc.
